description: Searches and filters film and TV productions. q matches the title only (not companies or people). stage: in-development | in-pre-production | in-production | in-post-production | completed. city / state / country match the shooting location (state is a two-letter US or Canadian code such as GA; UK regions by name, such as England). since = first detected on or after an ISO date; updated_since = changed on or after. Results are newest first. Each result includes its public page url, updated_at, and production_dates.start where known.

limit.description: Results per page (free tier caps at 20)

since.description: ISO date: only productions first detected on or after

state.description: Two-letter US state / Canadian province, or a UK region name

type.description: Production type slug, e.g. feature-film or series

updated_since.description: ISO date: only productions updated on or after

name: search_productions
title: Search productions
